title: Concept: SSH client accepts any host key (python)
description: In python, paramiko.AutoAddPolicy disables host-key verification for the SSH client. The first connection is exactly where an interposed server wins, and nothing later in the session re-checks the peer.
applicability: Deployment scripts, backup jobs and admin tooling that open SSH sessions from python; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Command, file and credential interception on every connection the client makes; HIGH severity.
